text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: The final race of the Classic Triple Crown, the Kikuka-sho, is drawing near—

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: —Hmph... hmph...

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: Phew...——Alright, I can still keep going!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: "If only Duramente wasn't here... I felt pathetic just for thinking that."

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Even when I heard about your injury,
before worrying, I was just shocked by how similar
your situation was to Teio-san's...

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
I'm at my lowest—but if I look away
from that ugly truth, I'll just stay
at rock bottom forever—

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: ...*Pant*... *hic*... *cough*, *cough*...

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: No... Not yet—more!!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
I hate staying at rock bottom!
I hate being weak and pathetic!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: —That's why I want to win.

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
I want to win――I *have* to win!
If I don't overcome my weakness and move forward, I'll never――

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: —Aaaaahh!!!!

text_block_list.name: Classmate Umamusume A
text_block_list.text:
Whoa, Kita-chan is on the track again...!
Hasn't she been out there non-stop lately...?

text_block_list.name: Classmate Umamusume B
text_block_list.text:
The Kikuka-sho is coming up soon, after all.
I hope she doesn't end up hurting herself...

text_block_list.name: Classmate Umamusume A
text_block_list.text:
Still, maybe Kita-chan will be just fine.
I mean, lately, Kita-chan has been—

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: —HAAAAAAAHH!!

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
What an incredible drive...
Once runners like that clear their minds, they're truly formidable.

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
I wonder how much stronger she'll be
by the next time she runs...

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text: So, have you made up your mind, Cheval? ...About what you're gonna do for the Kikuka Sho.

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text: (Never looking back, charging forward with all your might... Together with you, I—)

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
As I pondered whether to enter the Kikuka Sho,
Cheval Grand approached,
looking formal and serious.

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
Um... Trainer-san...
I-I-I have a favor to ask, but—

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
...The race... I want to run...
You told me before... that I could say it...

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text: T-That's why I... ...um—

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
T... The 'Kikuka Sho'... r-r...
r-r-r-run in it...!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Having gotten that far, Cheval Grand choked on her words.
It seemed she couldn't muster the courage to see it all the way through.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"However, you came to tell me what you wanted on your own.
Being able to do that is a big step forward."
choice_data_list: You want to run in the Kikuka Sho, right?
You want to run in the Kikuka Sho, don't you?

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text: ...Y-Yes!

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text: I want to run... to find out... I can't say for sure that I'll win... but—

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
"...A-Are you sure... really...?
I'm coming to you... at the very last minute..."
choice_data_list: If you want to enter, then you should enter.
If you want to enter, then you should.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The Kikuka-sho is, needless to say, a massive GⅠ stage.
We need to build a training regimen tailored specifically for it right away.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
We'll also need to prepare data on the other participating Umamusume right away.
Even so—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
She said "I want to run" of her own accord.
Knowing that fills me with such exhilarating joy.
choice_data_list: I'll prepare a special training menu for you right away!

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text: ……! Th-Thank you so much……!

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text: "I have to see for myself... what Kita-san is all about... To become a great Umamusume, I have to properly—"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: And so, training was rushed along at a rapid pace toward the Kikuka Sho—

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text: We've finally reached the final leg of the Classic Triple Crown races! Here at Kyoto Racecourse, the air is buzzing with the feverish excitement of the waiting crowd!

text_block_list.name: Analysis
text_block_list.text: Duramente, the heavy favorite, unfortunately had to withdraw due to injury—

text_block_list.name: Analysis
text_block_list.text:
Some runners will surely see this as an opportunity.
One can't take their eyes off how this will unfold.

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text:
"I can win... I will win...!
Today is my only chance... If it's today, I can do it too!"

text_block_list.name: Umamusume B
text_block_list.text:
I can do this, I can, I can!
If I win here... even someone like me can...!

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
(Ugh... I really can't stand it...
This tense, prickly atmosphere before a race...)

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
(I can't let myself be swallowed up...
If I falter here, there was no point in coming all this way...)

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: —Phewww...

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
(An unwavering gaze...
You really never flinch, do you?)

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
(I still haven't found my own strength,
a strength that's different from yours...)

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
(So for now, I'll just do what I can.
I promise I won't ever take my eyes off you—)
